history.lesson: NHL U8.5 lost twice on a high-scoring night; NHL alt unders are less safe than they look.

history.name: Hurricanes -1.5 (Puck Line)
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Nashville won 4-1. Carolina scored only once.
history.lesson: Road puck lines at plus money need a weak opposing goalie; Nashville at home was not that.

history.name: Champions League Safety Net
history.whyExplanation: Won: all 4 legs hit (Barcelona 3-0, LASK 4-0, Inter 3-0, PSG 6-0).
history.lesson: Big class-gap UCL legs (clear favorites, -1000 or longer) are reliable; this is where soccer legs belong.

history.name: College Opening Night Locks
history.whyExplanation: Won: all 13 power-conference home favorites won, the closest by 12 (UNLV).
history.lesson: College moneylines at -1800 or longer against low-major visitors went 13-for-13; keep this as the lottery backbone.

history.name: Ohio -14.5 (Alt Spread)
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Ohio won by only 8 (28-20).
history.lesson: MAC road favorites rarely blow teams out; don't lay two touchdowns in MACtion.

history.name: MACtion + Bolts

legs.event: Detroit Red Wings @ Tampa Bay Lightning

history.whyExplanation: Won: Ohio -3.5 (by 8), Miami +3.5 (lost by 3 in OT, just enough), Lightning ML (4-2).
history.lesson: Cushioned favorites worked, but Miami +3.5 survived by half a point; give more cushion where cheap.

history.name: Home Ice +1.5 Trio
history.whyExplanation: Won: Devils won in a shootout, Canadiens lost by 1 in OT, Wild won.
history.lesson: NHL +1.5 on evenly matched teams covered three times, and OT losses still cash.

history.name: NHL Unders & Cushions Ladder

legs.event: St. Louis Blues @ New York Rangers
Detroit Red Wings @ Tampa Bay Lightning

history.whyExplanation: Lost: 8 of 11 hit. Misses: Stars/Caps U7.5 (11), Jets/Canadiens U7.5 (9), Avalanche +1.5 (lost by 5).
history.lesson: Same two shootout games sank both NHL tickets. Correlated NHL unders on one night are a single point of failure; limit how many go on one ticket.

history.name: Rockets -8.5 (Alt Spread)
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Minnesota won 117-107 in Houston.
history.lesson: Laying 8+ with a team whose opponent is healthy and competent is a coin flip at best; no more alt-spread favorite singles over -6.

history.name: Double-Digit Dog Cushions
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Raptors +11.5 missed (lost by 19 at Denver). Cavaliers +11.5 and Bucks +20.5 hit.
history.lesson: Road dogs at altitude (Denver) on the 2nd leg of a trip get blown out; avoid cushions on teams visiting DEN.

history.name: UCL Class-Gap Safety Net
history.whyExplanation: Lost on Liverpool or Draw (-ish price): Fenerbahce beat Liverpool 3-2 in Istanbul. The other UCL legs were still in play at grading time.
history.lesson: An away 'or Draw' in a hostile UCL venue isn't a class-gap lock when the home side is a top-tier Turkish team. Keep UCL double chance to genuine mismatches (home favorites or road teams vs. minnows).

history.name: Home Ice & Memphis Cushion

legs.event: San Jose Sharks @ Los Angeles Kings

history.whyExplanation: Won: Kings won 7-2, Kraken won 2-1 in OT, Grizzlies lost by only 4.
history.lesson: NHL +1.5 on home teams keeps cashing (now 9-0 across tickets); keep it.

AEK vs Real Madrid Over 1.5 Goals

history.whyExplanation: Lost: 24 of 25 hit. Only miss was Bulls +24.5 (Knicks won 135-105, by 30).
history.lesson: Even 24-point cushions fail on a road dog in a blowout at MSG; when a cushion leg is an extreme number, skip it rather than assume it is a lock.

history.name: College Locks & Unders Ladder

legs.pick: Bristol City vs Wolves Under 4.5 Goals
Sao Paulo vs Corinthians Under 3.5 Goals

history.whyExplanation: Lost: 14 of 17 hit. Misses: Porto/Napoli U4.5 (5 goals), Lens/Como U4.5 (Como won 9-1), Spurs -2.5 (won by 1).
history.lesson: Soccer U4.5 in UCL games with attacking teams failed twice; small NBA favorite spreads (-2.5) are coin-flippy - use +1.5 instead.

history.name: Los Angeles Lakers -13.5
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Lakers won by exactly 13 (116-103).
history.lesson: Buying past a big moved number for plus money lost by a point; stay at or below the main line on double-digit favorites.

history.name: Favorites Getting Points
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Hornets +9.5 missed (lost by 10 at Brooklyn). Hawks and Pistons cushions hit.
history.lesson: Small road favorites can still lose by 10; a 13-point swing vs market is not enough when the home dog is rested.

history.name: West Coast Cushions
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Raptors +14.5 missed (lost by 19 at Denver). Blazers +9.5 and Heat +7.5 hit.
history.lesson: Second Toronto-at-Denver miss of the night: never take road dogs at Denver.

history.name: Rockets, Lakers & Kraken
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Rockets +3.5 missed (lost by 10 to Minnesota). Lakers -3.5 and Kraken +2.5 hit.
history.lesson: We misread Houston vs Minnesota twice in one day; no Rockets legs until form returns.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 23 of 25 hit. Misses: Pacers/Grizzlies Over 214.5 (210) and Lakers/Kings Over 219.5 (219, by half a point).
history.lesson: NBA alt overs ~14 below the main line went 12-2; the misses were lower-pace games. Need 18+ points of cushion on alt overs for slow teams.

history.name: Home Favorites Safety Ladder
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 11 of 14 hit. Misses: High Point -26.5 (won by 14), Loyola Marymount +0.5 (lost by 1), Eastern Michigan +12.5 (lost by 28).
history.lesson: College alt spreads of -20+ vs non-D1-level foes are unreliable (they rest starters); pick'em college legs are coin flips.

history.name: Europa Class-Gap Favorites

legs.event: Crvena Zvezda v Inter Club Escaldes

history.whyExplanation: LOST. Atalanta drew 1-1 at home with Kairat Almaty, so the moneyline missed. Crvena Zvezda won 2-1. Benfica/Copenhagen/Lugano were still in progress but the ticket was already dead.
history.lesson: A -1100 home favorite in UEFA Conference League can still draw a supposed mismatch (Atalanta 1-1 Kairat). Class-gap soccer MLs are not locks — prefer double chance unless the opponent is truly amateur-tier.

legs.actual: Lincoln Red Imps won 1-0 vs Hajduk Split

legs.pick: Sint Truiden vs Brann Over 1.5 Goals

history.whyExplanation: LOST. Dead early on AC Milan or Draw and Hajduk Split or Draw. Final settled soccer/NHL/NBA/NCAAF: 20 hit / 5 miss. Late misses also included Leverkusen or Draw (0-1 Marseille), Sunderland or Draw (0-2 Dinamo Zagreb), and UTSA +3.5 (lost by 31).
history.lesson: Away European 'or Draw' double chances failed twice in one window (Milan home to Ferencvaros; Hajduk at Lincoln Red Imps). Awkward away venues can upset 'class-gap' frames — prefer home double chance or team-to-score.

history.name: Jaguars @ Ravens Under 38.5
history.whyExplanation: LOST. JAX 33 BAL 10 — 43 total cleared 38.5. Backup QB game still went over as Jacksonville scored freely.
history.lesson: TNF unders with a backup QB need more than a soft total if the other offense is healthy and motivated.

history.name: Joe Fagnano Under 0.5 Passing TDs
history.whyExplanation: WON. Joe Fagnano threw 0 TD passes (10/18, 60 yards, 2 INT) in Baltimore's 33-10 loss.
history.lesson: Backup QB under 0.5 pass TD held when the offense was overmatched. Keep for true backups in bad matchups.

history.name: Home Ice +1.5 Trio
history.whyExplanation: LOST. Penguins got blown out 6-2 by Boston; Canadiens and Blue Jackets both covered +1.5.
history.lesson: NHL home +1.5 remains strong (2/3 here) but a true mismatch/home team in freefall (PIT) can still get run. Prefer +1.5 when the home side is at least average.

history.name: Prime-Time Cushions
history.whyExplanation: WON at +108. All four cushions hit: JAX -2.5 by 23, GS +4.5 win, COL +1.5 and EDM +1.5 each lost by 1.
history.lesson: Mixed-sport cushion parlays with real points (NFL -2.5 mismatch, NBA +4.5, NHL +1.5) paid. NHL +1.5 home/road cushions continue to cash.

history.name: College Locks Ladder
history.whyExplanation: WON at -473. All 11 college moneylines at -3500 or longer hit. Seton Hall was the closest (67-60).
history.lesson: College MLs at -1800 or longer are now 27-0 when followed. Keep as the Best Shot / ladder backbone.

history.name: Sacramento Kings +15.5
history.whyExplanation: WON. Spurs 124 Kings 109 — Sacramento lost by 15 and covered +15.5 by half a point.
history.lesson: Extreme NBA dog cushions (≥+15.5) can still cash in competitive losses. Keep ≥+9.5 minimum; bigger is safer vs elite.

history.name: Virginia Tech +4.5
history.whyExplanation: LOST. SMU 51 VT 28 — Hokies got blown out on the road and never threatened +4.5.
history.lesson: Small CFB road cushions (+4.5) are not high-prob when the home side is motivated and healthy. Prefer ≥+9.5 for dog singles.

history.name: Nevada +8.5
history.whyExplanation: LOST. New Mexico 31 Nevada 3 — home dog got crushed; +8.5 never had a chance.
history.lesson: Mountain West home dogs can still get run. +8.5 was under the ≥+9.5 cushion rule spirit — need more points or skip soft home dogs.

history.name: Home Ice +1.5 Trio
history.whyExplanation: LOST. Buffalo and Minnesota covered easily; Calgary lost 5-3 (by 2) and missed +1.5.
history.lesson: NHL home +1.5 remains strong (2/3) but struggling home clubs (CGY) can lose by 2+. Prefer average-or-better home teams only.

history.name: Friday College Locks
history.whyExplanation: WON at -5425. All three Power MLs hit. Wisconsin was the closest (73-64).
history.lesson: College MLs at -1800+ on dedicated lock parlays are now 34-0. Keep as the safest backbone.

history.name: Campus Alt Favorites
history.whyExplanation: LOST 0/3. Purdue fell in 2OT to Valpo; Kentucky won by only 9 vs JMU; UAB won by only 7 vs Nicholls. No leg covered.
history.lesson: Even bought-down Power/campus alts under the -20 ban (‑19.5/‑13.5/‑10.5) failed in one night — early-season hosts can lose outright or fail mid spreads. Prefer -1800+ MLs over campus alt favorites.

topLessons: College MLs at -1800+ are 34-0 on lock parlays — prefer those over any campus alt favorite.
Campus alt favorites went 0-3 Friday (Purdue lost outright; UK/UAB failed mid spreads) — even under the -20 ban, early-season hosts are not automatic.
NBA ≥+9.5 cushions still fail in true mismatches (CHA/MEM blowouts) — buy EXTRA points vs elite (used +12.5/+14.5 today).
NHL home +1.5 missed on CGY (lost by 2); prefer average-or-better homes or take the +1.5 on the pick'em dog instead of a coin-flip ML.
Do not reuse eventIds from pending Fri PM / Sunday NFL tickets — morning burn is real.
